authority: Explicit root delegation of user request to clean unused compilation intermediates; exact 17 caches, three worktree dist directories and seven local test binaries only.
symlinkPolicy: Never follow symlinks; reject candidate root symlinks and any symlink ancestor; nested links are recorded then unlinked only.
preservation: No root release, node_modules, packages, source, tracked evidence/results/manifests/logs, application data, audio or Android device scene touched.
spaceDeltaLimit: Observed shared-volume free-space change may include concurrent root cleanup and system allocation; do not attribute full delta to this script.
